_doc: P3-FGT-23: Bip01 joints of the Artec 3D 'Body scan' (https://www.artec3d.com/3d-models/body-scan, CC BY 4.0) in its double-biceps flex pose, metres, after 00_scan_prep.py's normalisation (upright, feet on z = 0, pelvis-centred, facing -Y; the fighter's left is +X).
